Since 233 is prime, Fermat gives \(71^{232}\equiv 1 \pmod{233}\).  
So \(71^{390}\equiv 71^{158}\pmod{233}\).

Powers:
\[
71^2\equiv 148,\quad 71^4\equiv 2,\quad 71^8\equiv 4,\quad 71^{16}\equiv 16,\quad 71^{128}\equiv 8
\]
Since \(158=128+16+8+4+2\):
\[
71^{158}\equiv 8\cdot 16\cdot 4\cdot 2\cdot 148 \equiv 102 \pmod{233}
\]

FINAL: 102
